outcome: Prioritize customers at risk of missing aftersales visits and measure retained-service revenue through a controlled campaign.
overview: Help aftersales teams focus campaigns on customers at risk of missing service visits. Establish a time-based model evaluation and a campaign holdout before measuring retained revenue. UAE automotive groups are the first target. India and Turkey fit is a proposed extension of the same workflow.
kpi: Incremental service-return rate against a holdout group
scope: Planning estimate: four to six weeks for model and integration build, followed by the chosen service-return measurement window. Deliver a churn definition, quality report, evaluated model, scored segment, campaign experiment and monitoring runbook. The aftersales owner accepts the business rules. The campaign owner authorizes launch.
